name: cc-worktree-radar
description: The worktree-radar mod for Claude Code: a live view of your parallel branches and worktrees above the prompt

plugins.name: worktree-radar
plugins.description: A live radar of your parallel branches and worktrees above the prompt: which merge cleanly, which conflict, which are stacked, which a Claude session is still working on, and the order to land them. Read-only: it never merges, rebases or moves a ref.
